RUN printf '%s\n' anyio==4.13.0 av==17.0.1 backports-tarfile==1.2.0 backports-zstd==1.5.0 build==1.5.0 cachecontrol==0.14.4 certifi==2026.5.20 cffi==2.0.0 charset-normalizer==3.4.7 cleo==2.1.0 crashtest==0.4.1 cryptography==48.0.0 distlib==0.4.1 dulwich==1.2.6 fastjsonschema==2.21.2 filelock==3.29.1 findpython==0.8.0 h11==0.16.0 httpcore==1.0.9 httpx==0.28.1 idna==3.18 importlib-metadata==9.0.0 installer==1.0.1 jaraco-classes==3.4.0 jaraco-context==6.1.2 jaraco-functools==4.5.0 jeepney==0.9.0 keyring==25.7.0 more-itertools==11.1.0 msgpack==1.1.2 packaging==26.2 pbs-installer==2026.6.2 pkginfo==1.12.1.2 platformdirs==4.10.0 poetry==2.4.1 poetry-core==2.4.0 pycparser==3.0 pyproject-hooks==1.2.0 python-discovery==1.4.0 rapidfuzz==3.14.5 requests==2.34.2 requests-toolbelt==1.0.0 secretstorage==3.5.0 shellingham==1.5.4 tomlkit==0.15.0 trove-classifiers==2026.6.1.19 typing-extensions==4.15.0 urllib3==2.7.0 virtualenv==21.4.2 zipp==4.1.0 > /tmp/jayint-pip-constraints.txt
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'python3 -m pip install pytest pytest-xdist poetry' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
WORKDIR /app
COPY . /app

ENV PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
ENV PIP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT=300
ENV PIP_RETRIES=5

RUN printf '%s\n' 'Acquire::Retries "5";' 'Acquire::http::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::https::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::http::Pipeline-Depth "0";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99jayint-retries

RUN JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_APT_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /bin/sh -lc 'apt-get update && apt-get install -y ffmpeg libavformat-dev libavcodec-dev libavdevice-dev libavutil-dev libavfilter-dev libswscale-dev libswresample-dev pkg-config' && JAYINT_APT_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_APT_STATUS=$?; (apt-get clean >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; if [ "$JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_APT_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_APT_STATUS"
RUN if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then sed -i 's/av = "^11.0.0"/av = ">=12.0.0"/' pyproject.toml; fi

RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'poetry run pip install numpy==1.26.4 pil pydantic==2.7.4 && poetry run pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps opencv-python-headless' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
